hul_diver.text: I dive in the big tank every morning to clean the glass. The sharks watch me like I'm the show. To be fair, I am.
The Deep calls itself a submarium: an aquarium you go down into. Start at the top with the ice, end at the bottom with the deep-sea things that make their own light.

hul_kid.text: Miss said anglerfish make light with bacteria. Bacteria! In its face! That's the best thing I've ever heard.
I'm going to be a marine biologist. Or a shark. Whichever.
